sentences.text: Das Büro ist neben dem Bahnhof.
sentences.en: The office is next to the train station.

sentences.text: Der Hund liegt neben dem Bett.
sentences.en: The dog is lying next to the bed.
He was standing next to me.
She lives next door to us.

sentences.text: Neben der Schule gibt es einen Garten.
sentences.en: There's a garden next to the school.

sentences.text: Wir stellen den Tisch neben das Fenster.
sentences.en: We're putting the table next to the window.

sentences.text: Neben Deutsch spricht sie auch Französisch.
sentences.en: Besides German, she also speaks French.

sentences.text: Neben der Arbeit hat er keine Zeit für seine Familie.
sentences.en: Alongside his work he has no time for his family.
sentences.review: 'Neben der Arbeit hat er keine Zeit für seine Familie' reads oddly, because 'neben' means 'in addition to' and so clashes with 'no time', and the English 'Alongside his work he has no time' is awkward. Suggested fix: 'Neben der Arbeit hat er kaum Zeit für seine Familie' with the English 'Besides work, he has hardly any time for his family', or a clearer 'besides' example.
